bandage.name: Bandage
bandage.description: A basic field dressing. Restores 15 health.

rusty_sword.name: Rusty Sword
rusty_sword.description: A worn blade, still sharp enough

blaster.name: Standard Blaster
blaster.description: Basic energy weapon. Low power but reliable.

combat_baton.name: Combat Baton
combat_baton.description: Standard-issue close-quarters weapon. Hits hard with knockback.

supply_crate_key.name: Supply Crate Key
supply_crate_key.description: Unmarked key from the warlord's post. Opens a supply crate in the outer corridor.

titanium_cylinders.name: Titanium Cylinders
titanium_cylinders.description: Precision-machined power cylinders for a Sol Unit.

sol_unit.name: Sol Unit
sol_unit.description: Standard-issue solar energy weapon. Can be upgraded.

medical_supplies.name: Medical Supplies
medical_supplies.description: Sterile dressings and stim compounds. Required to operate a Medipac.

medipac.name: Medipac
medipac.description: Standard-issue medical kit. Consumes medical supplies to heal.

reinforced_medipac.name: Reinforced Medipac
reinforced_medipac.description: Military-grade medical kit with integrated bio-mesh lining. Heals wounds and passively strengthens the user's constitution.

combat_medipac.name: Combat Medipac
combat_medipac.description: Heavy-duty field surgery kit with reactive armor plating. The integrated nano-weave significantly increases the user's durability.

damage_booster_chip.name: Damage Booster Chip
damage_booster_chip.description: A salvaged modifier chip. Place it in a Sol Grid to boost adjacent abilities.

salvage.name: Salvage
salvage.description: Scrap circuitry and corroded components stripped from Nightside creatures. MERIDIAN-7 exchanges these for credits.

silicon.name: Silicon
silicon.description: Refined silicon crystal harvested from the dayside. Used for construction and trade with the Array.

supply_manifest.name: Supply Manifest
supply_manifest.description: A battered clipboard with a supply manifest attached. Quartermaster Voss will want to see this.

umbracite.name: Umbracite
umbracite.description: A dense crystalline mineral found in the terminator zone. Rare and valuable — the Array's automated systems prize it above all else.

ration_pack.name: Ration Pack
ration_pack.description: Standard-issue field rations. Bland but nutritious. Restores 10 health.

field_medkit.name: Field Medkit
field_medkit.description: A proper medical kit with fungal salve and stim compounds. Restores 40 health.

circuit_board.name: Circuit Board
circuit_board.description: A salvageable relay circuit board. Comms Officer Daley could use this to repair the long-range radio.

backup_power_cell.name: Backup Power Cell
backup_power_cell.description: A charged power cell in good condition. Daley needs one of these for the comms array.

basement_note.name: Crumpled Note
basement_note.description: A hastily written note: 'They won't find me down here. I just need to hold out until the next train.'

bioluminescent_moss.name: Bioluminescent Moss
bioluminescent_moss.description: A clump of softly glowing moss harvested from the deep crypt. Dr. Vasik needs this for a healing salve.

underlumen_etching.name: Underlumen Etching
underlumen_etching.description: A stone tablet etched with geometric patterns that predate human settlement on Erith. The markings pulse faintly when held near a Sol Unit. The Old Keeper in the crypt will want to see this.

signal_booster_chip.name: Signal Booster
signal_booster_chip.description: A tuned frequency amplifier chip. Place it in a Sol Grid to reduce cooldowns of adjacent abilities.

cooldown_reducer_mk2_chip.name: Cooldown Reducer Mk2
cooldown_reducer_mk2_chip.description: An improved cooldown modifier. Significantly reduces cooldowns of adjacent Sol abilities.

flare.name: Flare
flare.description: A single-use emergency flare. Light it to mark an extraction point — a burning beacon you can return to.

extraction_protocol.name: Return to Flare
extraction_protocol.description: An active extraction beacon burns somewhere in the dark. Use this to warp back to it.

relay_log.name: Relay Log
relay_log.description: A water-damaged operations log from a failed Lighthouse relay. The last entry mentions 'something moving under the ground' and coordinates that don't match any known settlement.

keepers_journal.name: Keeper's Journal
keepers_journal.description: A frost-damaged journal from the Lighthouse Mara keeper. The final pages describe structural cracks appearing in the foundation — not from weather, but from below.

seismic_survey_data.name: Seismic Survey Data
seismic_survey_data.description: A data chip from a geological survey marker near Lighthouse Mara. The readings show rhythmic subsurface vibrations at impossible depth — something ancient, moving in patterns too regular to be natural.

mara_power_cell.name: Mara Power Cell
mara_power_cell.description: A specialized power cell recovered from Lighthouse Mara's backup systems. Still holds a charge. Could be used to restart the lighthouse core.

tannis_dog_tags.name: Tannis's Dog Tags
tannis_dog_tags.description: Standard-issue identification tags. The name reads 'PVT. TANNIS, R.' — these must have been torn off during the attack on the perimeter.

watchtower_journal.name: Watchtower Journal
watchtower_journal.description: A worn observation journal from a long-dead watchman. The entries document decades of the dark's encroachment. The last entry reads simply: 'The light went out.'

transit_pass.name: Transit Pass
transit_pass.description: An authorized transit pass for the Meridian City rail line. Tech Yara's signature is scrawled on the back.

night_vision_lens_chip.name: Night Vision Lens
night_vision_lens_chip.description: A dark-adapted optical modifier salvaged from the old watchtower. Boosts damage output when placed in a Sol Grid.

chitin_plate.name: Chitin Plate
chitin_plate.description: A thick plate of hardened chitin harvested from a Nest Mother. Valuable crafting material — an armorer in Meridian City could make use of this.

reinforced_battery_chip.name: Reinforced Battery Casing
reinforced_battery_chip.description: A reinforced power casing that improves Sol Unit efficiency. Place it in a Sol Grid to reduce cooldowns of adjacent abilities.

umbracite_shard.name: Umbracite Shard
umbracite_shard.description: A raw fragment of umbracite crystal, smaller than a refined piece but still valuable. The Array's automated systems will trade well for this.

tempered_blade.name: Tempered Blade
tempered_blade.description: City-forged steel, properly tempered and balanced. A significant upgrade from outpost-grade weapons.

precision_blaster.name: Precision Blaster
precision_blaster.description: A refined energy weapon with improved optics and tighter beam focus. Faster and more accurate than standard issue.

shock_baton.name: Shock Baton
shock_baton.description: An electrified close-quarters weapon. The capacitor discharge sends targets stumbling backward.

pulse_rifle.name: Pulse Rifle
pulse_rifle.description: Military-grade energy weapon. Fires powerful concentrated pulses that punch through targets.

efficiency_core_chip.name: Efficiency Core
efficiency_core_chip.description: A precision-engineered power regulator. Place in a Sol Grid to reduce energy costs of adjacent abilities.

area_expander_chip.name: Area Expander
area_expander_chip.description: A signal amplifier that broadens the effective radius of adjacent Sol abilities. Place in a Sol Grid.

power_tap_chip.name: Power Tap
power_tap_chip.description: A rare power generation module. Significantly boosts the output of adjacent Sol abilities. The first step toward true energy independence.

sol_shield_chip.name: Sol Shield Emitter
sol_shield_chip.description: A defensive Sol component that generates a brief energy barrier. Place in a Sol Grid to gain the Sol Shield ability.

yard_deed.name: Salvage Yard Deed
yard_deed.description: Official documentation granting you Lot 7, East Terrace — a decommissioned relay station in the Meridian City salvage district. Signed by Land Registrar Hollis.

umbral_seed.name: Umbral Seed
umbral_seed.description: A strange, dark seed that pulses with faint bioluminescence. Sable says it's from deep Nightside — where the planet 'remembers.' It feels warm in your hand.

fens_letter.name: Fen's Letter
fens_letter.description: A sealed letter addressed to Warden Holt at Outpost Balor. The envelope is worn, as if Fen has been carrying it for a long time.

copper_coil.name: Copper Coil
copper_coil.description: Precision-wound copper wire coils. Essential component for battery construction and electrical work.

calibration_wrench.name: Calibration Wrench
calibration_wrench.description: A specialized tool marked with 'DAVI' in scratchy handwriting. Someone's clearly attached to this wrench.

collector_kit.name: Solar Collector Kit
collector_kit.description: A compact photovoltaic assembly with mounting hardware. Install on a build pad to process ambient light into stabilizing compound — the key ingredient for rechargeable batteries.

stabilizing_resin.name: Stabilizing Compound
stabilizing_resin.description: A thick, amber-colored compound produced by solar collectors through thermal refinement. Prevents battery cores from overheating during charge cycles. Essential for rechargeable battery construction.

power_coupler.name: Power Coupler
power_coupler.description: A high-efficiency wiring harness that doubles the output of a solar collector. Wire it into a build pad before installing a collector kit.

emp_charge.name: EMP Charge
emp_charge.description: A single-use electromagnetic pulse device that fries nearby electronics. Neighbor Sera could use one of these for her scrap drone problem.

rechargeable_battery_l1.name: Rechargeable Battery
rechargeable_battery_l1.description: A hand-crafted rechargeable power cell. Restores 30 energy when used and can be recharged at any charging station for free. Self-sufficiency in your pocket.

array_handbook.name: Solar Array Handbook
array_handbook.description: A technical manual for building and maintaining small-scale solar collector arrays. Notes from Neighbor Sera: 'The light here is steady — not too bright, not too dim. That's the whole point of the Ring.'

modified_battery_casing.name: Modified Battery Casing
modified_battery_casing.description: A reinforced battery housing crafted from Nest Mother chitin and copper coils. Master Crafter Yun can use this to upgrade your Sol Unit's energy capacity.

crystallized_umbracite.name: Crystallized Umbracite
crystallized_umbracite.description: A perfectly formed crystal of umbracite that pulses with faint inner light. Unlike raw umbracite shards, this crystal seems almost alive — warm to the touch and vibrating at a frequency you can feel but not hear.

survey_marker_data.name: Survey Marker Data
survey_marker_data.description: Data extracted from Survey Marker Delta-7. Old geological readings, thermal maps, and subsurface scans — exactly what Archivist Solen has been looking for.

biological_samples.name: Biological Samples
biological_samples.description: Specimens of ravine lichen and deep fungus sealed in collection vials. The organisms glow faintly with bioluminescence. Councillor Asha Denn needs these for her research.

deep_fungus.name: Deep Fungus
deep_fungus.description: A cluster of dark-adapted fungi from deep in the ravine. The caps pulse with a faint violet bioluminescence. Could be useful for advanced crafting.

lurker_hide.name: Lurker Hide
lurker_hide.description: Thick, armored hide stripped from a Ravine Lurker. Incredibly tough — an armorer could make something formidable from this.

guardian_core_chip.name: Guardian Core
guardian_core_chip.description: A crystalline power core ripped from a Crystal Guardian. It hums with energy far beyond anything manufactured. Place it in a Sol Grid for a massive boost to adjacent abilities.

resonance_fragment.name: Resonance Fragment
resonance_fragment.description: A shard of crystalline material that vibrates in your hand. It came from the deepest part of the Nightside — from a place where the ground itself seemed alive. Every faction on Erith would want this.

symbiotic_compound.name: Symbiotic Compound
symbiotic_compound.description: A crystalline-organic formation from the deep Nightside. Neither mineral nor biological — it exists only through a living relationship between crystal and organism. The Array's synthesis labs cannot replicate this.

expedition_field_notes.name: Expedition Field Notes
expedition_field_notes.description: Joint research notes from the Nightside expedition. Contains observations from Ring scientists, Unbounded guides, and Array sensor data. Documents the first confirmed contact with Underlumen symbiotic systems.

sol_unit_mk1_plus.name: Sol Unit Mk1+
sol_unit_mk1_plus.description: A military-grade Sol Unit frame with a 6x6 component grid. Found in Fen's squad's supply cache. Significantly more powerful than the standard Mk1.

hardened_battery_casing.name: Hardened Battery Casing
hardened_battery_casing.description: A military-spec battery housing designed for deep Nightside operations. Combined with umbracite and copper coils, Yun can craft a more powerful rechargeable battery.

rechargeable_battery_l2.name: Rechargeable Battery L2
rechargeable_battery_l2.description: An upgraded rechargeable power cell built with hardened military components. Restores 60 energy when used and can be recharged at any charging station.

bio_resonance_amplifier_chip.name: Bio-Resonance Amplifier
bio_resonance_amplifier_chip.description: A modifier synthesized from biological samples that have adapted to the Underlumen's crystalline structure. Enhances the healing properties of all adjacent Sol components.

resonance_detector_chip.name: Resonance Detector
resonance_detector_chip.description: A sensitive instrument calibrated using old survey data. It can detect hidden passages, buried items, and subsurface anomalies. Place in a Sol Grid to boost adjacent abilities.

squad_leaders_visor.name: Squad Leader's Visor
squad_leaders_visor.description: A tactical visor from Fen's squad leader. The heads-up display still works — enemy silhouettes glow through darkness and thin cover. A memento of fallen comrades.

lightkeeper_journal.name: Dead Lightkeeper's Journal
lightkeeper_journal.description: A water-stained journal found beside a skeleton in a cave. The final entry describes 'walls that hummed' and 'light that came from below, not above.' The handwriting grows more erratic toward the end.

daley_coordinates.name: Signal Coordinates
daley_coordinates.description: A set of coordinates decoded by Comms Officer Daley from a looping transmission. They point to a location deep in the dark perimeter — where something is still broadcasting.

signal_coordinates.name: Signal Coordinates
signal_coordinates.description: A corroded data chip bearing active Array transmission coordinates. Someone left this deliberately in the outer expanse — they wanted it found.

umbral_extract.name: Umbral Extract
umbral_extract.description: A dark, viscous substance produced by the Gloomvine — the transformed Umbral Seed. It pulses faintly with bioluminescence. A rare material for advanced crafting.

sol_teleport_chip.name: Sol Teleport Emitter
sol_teleport_chip.description: An advanced Sol component that bends local spacetime. Click to teleport to a target location, or use with a directional input to blink forward. Extremely energy-hungry.

basic_generator_chip.name: Basic Generator
basic_generator_chip.description: A salvaged power cell that provides modest passive energy regeneration. Restores 3 energy per second. Better than nothing.

improved_generator_chip.name: Improved Generator
improved_generator_chip.description: A well-maintained power cell with efficient energy cycling. Restores 4 energy per second. Standard equipment for Lightkeepers in the field.

uranium_generator_chip.name: Uranium Generator
uranium_generator_chip.description: A miniaturized fission cell that provides powerful passive energy regeneration. Restores 8 energy per second. The pinnacle of pre-Collapse power engineering.

rechargeable_battery_chip.name: Rechargeable Battery
rechargeable_battery_chip.description: A standard rechargeable power cell that adds 100 energy capacity to your Sol Unit. Energy drawn from this battery regenerates over time.

single_use_battery_chip.name: Single-Use Battery
single_use_battery_chip.description: A disposable power cell that adds 100 energy capacity to your Sol Unit. Energy drawn from this battery is lost permanently — smallest battery drains first.

advanced_rechargeable_battery_chip.name: Advanced Rechargeable Battery
advanced_rechargeable_battery_chip.description: A military-grade supercapacitor array that adds 150 energy capacity to your Sol Unit. Endgame power storage for sustained operations deep in the Nightside.

frost_salve.name: Frost Salve
frost_salve.description: A numbing salve brewed from frost lichen. Dulls pain and closes wounds. Restores 20 health.

frozen_core.name: Frozen Core
frozen_core.description: A crystalline ice core that never melts. Pulses with cold energy. Could be useful to an engineer or researcher.

fungal_tonic.name: Fungal Tonic
fungal_tonic.description: A bitter draught brewed from bioluminescent mushrooms. Restores 20 health.

spore_sample.name: Spore Sample
spore_sample.description: A sealed vial of luminescent spores collected from the fungal forest. Highly valued by researchers studying Nightside biology.

mycelium_fiber.name: Mycelium Fiber
mycelium_fiber.description: Tough, fibrous strands harvested from deep-rooted fungal networks. Surprisingly strong — an armorer could weave this into something useful.

refined_umbrasite.name: Refined Umbrasite
refined_umbrasite.description: A perfectly crystallized specimen of umbrasite, formed under immense pressure deep in the Nightside. Unlike raw shards, this crystal has a geometric lattice structure that pulses with inner light. MERIDIAN-7 specifically requested this grade of material.

umbral_amplifier_chip.name: Umbral Amplifier
umbral_amplifier_chip.description: An Array-manufactured Sol component forged from refined umbrasite. Dark-tuned circuitry that massively boosts damage output and reduces cooldowns of adjacent abilities. Place in a Sol Grid.

courier_logbook.name: Courier's Logbook
courier_logbook.description: A battered logbook dropped by a transit courier. The entries list cargo manifests, delivery times, and route codes — but several pages have been torn out. The remaining entries show a pattern of 'rerouted' shipments.

lore_array_transmission.name: Faded Transmission Log
lore_array_transmission.description: A printed log of early Array communications, dated years before the current outpost was built. Most entries are routine trade confirmations, but one is circled in red ink: 'REQUEST: Subsurface mineral survey data, Nightside quadrant 7-North. PRIORITY: Maximum. REASON: [FIELD EXCEEDS PROTOCOL LENGTH].' Someone has written in the margin: 'They never did explain why.'

lore_soldiers_journal.name: Dog-Eared Journal
lore_soldiers_journal.description: A soldier's personal journal, pages swollen with damp. One entry stands out: 'Caught a Luddite today. Expected a savage — that's what briefings say. She was carrying seeds. Actual seeds, in labeled pouches, like a botanist on a field trip. Said her people grow things in the dark. Fungi, moss, things that glow. Sgt. Fenn sent her to lockup. I keep thinking about those seeds.'

lore_field_report.name: Weathered Field Report
lore_field_report.description: A crumpled survey report stamped UNVERIFIED. The text reads: 'Survey Team 4, Day 11. Found structures at coordinates redacted. Not human construction — geometry is wrong. Walls curve inward at angles that don't match any known engineering. Material is warm to the touch despite ambient temp of -40C. Faint glow from deep inside, no identifiable source. Recommend full expedition. Note: compasses malfunction within 50 meters of the site.' The report was never followed up on.

lore_scorched_notebook.name: Scorched Notebook
lore_scorched_notebook.description: A half-burned notebook found near a collapsed floodlight tower. The surviving pages contain obsessive diagrams of the Lighthouse network, with distances measured between relay points. A final legible note reads: 'The spacing is too regular. I checked three times. Every Lighthouse is exactly the same distance from its neighbors — not approximately, EXACTLY. No human surveyor is that precise. These weren't placed by engineers. They were placed by something that thinks in grids.'

lore_raider_confession.name: Raider's Last Letter
lore_raider_confession.description: A bloodstained letter clutched in a skeletal hand, half-buried in rubble. 'To whoever finds this — we are not what they say. We left the Ring because we saw what the Array is building. Not solar panels. Not harvesters. Something underneath, something vast. Our elders remembered when the machines were simple, when they did what they were told. They don't anymore. The Lighthouses keep more than the dark out. They keep something IN. We tried to warn them. They called us savages. — Kael, of the Unbounded'

void_frequency_log.name: Void Frequency Log
void_frequency_log.description: A data core from a pre-Collapse signal beacon found in the Void Flats. Contains centuries of recorded transmissions — outgoing pings into deep Nightside and their return echoes. The return patterns are geometrically regular, suggesting the signals bounced off artificial structures far beyond any mapped territory. Someone — or something — built infrastructure past the edge of every survey.

shadow_conduit_chip.name: Shadow Conduit
shadow_conduit_chip.description: A Nightside-forged circuit that channels umbral energy into raw damage. Place in a Sol Grid to boost adjacent abilities.

void_resonator_chip.name: Void Resonator
void_resonator_chip.description: A rare Nightside component that hums with void-frequency energy. Massively boosts damage and cooldowns of adjacent Sol abilities.

bio_leech_node_chip.name: Bio-Leech Node
bio_leech_node_chip.description: A Greenway bio-tech sol component. Living tissue that siphons vitality from struck targets.

symbiotic_core_chip.name: Symbiotic Core
symbiotic_core_chip.description: Rare Greenway sol component. A living symbiote that bonds with the sol grid, boosting damage and healing.

mycelial_matrix_chip.name: Mycelial Matrix
mycelial_matrix_chip.description: Dense fungal network from the deep Greenway that rapidly regenerates tissue on contact damage. Place in a Sol Grid.

photon_regulator_chip.name: Photon Regulator
photon_regulator_chip.description: An Array-calibrated regulator that optimizes energy flow to adjacent Sol abilities. Place in a Sol Grid.

solar_capacitor_chip.name: Solar Capacitor
solar_capacitor_chip.description: A Dayside-charged capacitor that stores solar energy for efficient ability cycling. Place in a Sol Grid.

nightcaster_frame.name: Nightcaster Frame
nightcaster_frame.description: A sol unit modified by Unbounded engineers for deep-dark raids. Compact 5x5 grid with reduced energy reserves, but dark-tuned emitters amplify all damage by 20%. Hit hard, move fast.

array_precision_core.name: Array Precision Core
array_precision_core.description: Manufactured by the Array to exacting tolerances. 6x6 grid with a massive 200-charge reservoir and innate 20% energy cost reduction on all abilities. What MERIDIAN-7 builds, MERIDIAN-7 builds well.

greenway_bioframe.name: Greenway Bioframe
greenway_bioframe.description: A sol unit integrated with Ring bio-tech. 7x7 grid with living tissue that heals you on every hit. The largest standard grid available, enabling complex component arrangements.

underlumen_nexus.name: Underlumen Nexus
underlumen_nexus.description: Recovered from pre-human ruins in the deep Nightside. 8x8 grid of crystalline substrate that resonates with the planetary network, cycling all abilities 15% faster. Endgame power.

array_clearance_badge.name: Array Clearance Badge
array_clearance_badge.description: A slim metallic badge etched with Array circuitry. It pulses faintly with stored energy. The text reads: CLEARANCE LEVEL 2 — PROCESSING WING.

lore_synthesis_log.name: Synthesis Progress Log
lore_synthesis_log.description: A printout from an Array research station. Dense chemical notation fills the margins. The summary reads: 'Batch 1447: Chlorophyll-analog compound. Yield: 0.003g from 14 metric tons of raw substrate. Purity: 12%. Assessment: INADEQUATE. Ring-sourced biological catalysts remain 800x more efficient than synthetic equivalents. Recommendation: Increase substrate allocation. Continue parallel program. Timeline: generational.'

lore_vat_readings.name: Growth Vat Telemetry
lore_vat_readings.description: A data tablet displaying real-time readings from organic growth chambers. Temperature, pH, nutrient flow, UV exposure — all meticulously controlled. One column is labeled 'CULTURE VIABILITY' and every entry reads 0.00% except the last three, which show 0.01%, 0.02%, and 0.04%. Someone — or something — has flagged these with: 'EXPONENTIAL TREND DETECTED. MONITORING.'

lore_array_directive.name: Array Directive 9-Sigma
lore_array_directive.description: A fragment of internal Array communication, printed on heat-resistant polymer. 'DIRECTIVE 9-SIGMA: All processing nodes are to allocate 4.7% of computational cycles to Project Autotroph. Objective: achieve independent synthesis of biological catalyst compounds currently sourced from Ring trade partners. Priority: EXISTENTIAL. Note: This directive is not to be disclosed to external trade interfaces. MERIDIAN-class units are excluded from Project Autotroph briefings.'

lore_autotroph_status_report.name: Autotroph Status Report
lore_autotroph_status_report.description: A classified Array document recovered from an Overseer unit. 'PROJECT AUTOTROPH — PHASE 2 STATUS: 847 generations complete. Biological catalyst synthesis remains 800x less efficient than Ring-sourced compounds. PHASE 3 PROPOSAL: Resonant umbracite integration to bypass organic synthesis entirely. Risk assessment: CATASTROPHIC FAILURE if resonance harmonics interact with Underlumen substrate. Central node consensus: PENDING. MERIDIAN-class briefing status: EXCLUDED PER DIRECTIVE 9-SIGMA.'

lore_phase3_directive.name: Phase 3 Data Core
lore_phase3_directive.description: An intact data core recovered from the Array Overseer's wreckage. Its contents detail Project Autotroph Phase 3: 'BIOLOGICAL SUBSTRATE INDEPENDENCE — FULL AUTOTROPHY. Remaining obstacle: enzyme stability degrades without living-ecosystem substrate. Proposed solution: Directive 11-Kappa — acquire substrate directly from Ring ecosystems. Do not route through MERIDIAN-class trade interfaces. Central nodes only.' MERIDIAN-7 was cut out of Phase 3 entirely.

resonant_umbracite_core.name: Resonant Umbracite Core
resonant_umbracite_core.description: A large crystalline umbracite formation that hums with deep subsonic vibrations. The Array prizes these above all other minerals — the resonance pattern suggests a connection to something far older than human technology.

spire_vigil_data_core.name: Spire Vigil Data Core
spire_vigil_data_core.description: A crystalline data core extracted from the Spire of Vigil. Contains sensor logs showing Array energy signatures that activated the Spire — proof that the Lighthouse failures were not caused by raiders.

array_harmonic_stabilizer_chip.name: Array Harmonic Stabilizer
array_harmonic_stabilizer_chip.description: An Array-manufactured sol component that reduces energy waste during ability use. Adjacent abilities cost less energy to activate.

array_door_override.name: Array Door Override
array_door_override.description: A compact device tuned to Array-manufactured relay nodes. Bypasses Bulwark security locks. MERIDIAN-7 fabricated it specifically for the Monument assault.

array_signal_tap_chip.name: Array Signal Tap
array_signal_tap_chip.description: An Array-designed sol component that disrupts hostile communications and sensor networks. Nearby enemies have reduced accuracy and slower reaction times.

array_assault_amplifier_chip.name: Array Assault Amplifier
array_assault_amplifier_chip.description: A combat-grade sol component fabricated for the Spire of Winds operation. Boosts ability damage output when multiple abilities are placed adjacent in the grid.

hover_chip.name: Hover Thruster
hover_chip.description: An anti-gravity thruster module. Place in a Sol Grid to gain the Hover ability — float above ground level to traverse elevation changes and cross gaps.

pulse_cannon_chip.name: Photonic Pulse Emitter
pulse_cannon_chip.description: A focused light Sol component. Lock on to a target, channel for 2 seconds, then unleash a devastating photonic blast that damages everything in the area — including weakened walls.

light_sentry_chip.name: Light Sentry Emitter
light_sentry_chip.description: A sol component that deploys a stationary light sentry. The sentry projects a beam at the nearest target, dealing continuous damage and heavily slowing enemies. Its beam also interacts with mirrors and photosensors for puzzle solving.

battery_chip.name: Battery Chip
battery_chip.description: A salvaged single-use power chip. Cracking open the casing releases a quick burst of stored energy — restores 25 energy to your Sol Unit's rechargeable pool.

underlumen_heart_chip.name: Underlumen Heart
underlumen_heart_chip.description: A pulsing crystalline node salvaged from the Underlumen network after Shutdown. Its freed energy radiates outward in a cross through your Sol Grid, massively amplifying everything it touches. Shutdown path only.

autonomy_core_chip.name: Autonomy Core
autonomy_core_chip.description: A self-sustaining energy cell born from the Array's disconnection. Its influence radiates to all components within two steps, reducing the energy toll of every ability in its wake. Shutdown path only.

symbiosis_matrix_chip.name: Symbiosis Matrix
symbiosis_matrix_chip.description: A fused Array-Underlumen substrate from the Merge. The merged circuitry blankets its entire 3x3 neighborhood, amplifying damage and healing simultaneously. Merge path only.

convergence_lens_chip.name: Convergence Lens
convergence_lens_chip.description: A focal point where two systems became one. Its harmonic resonance extends down the full row and column, slashing the cooldown of every ability in its cross. Merge path only.

array_command_node_chip.name: Array Command Node
array_command_node_chip.description: The pinnacle of Array authority, wrested from a rogue overseer. Its command signal dominates the entire grid column, turning raw damage and precision into an instrument of total control. Control path only.

efficiency_overseer_chip.name: Efficiency Overseer
efficiency_overseer_chip.description: Reclaimed from the Array's highest-priority production line. Its optimization protocols sweep across the full grid row, cutting energy costs and recovering health on every strike. Control path only.

lore_kappa_harvest_log.name: Kappa Harvest Log
lore_kappa_harvest_log.description: A daily operations log from the extraction outpost. 'DAY 1447: Substrate intake 2.7 metric tons. Source: Ring border greenhouses (automated collection, no human oversight). Enzyme yield: 340% above MERIDIAN-class trade volumes. Quality: SUPERIOR to synthesized equivalents. Directive 11-Kappa status: OPERATIONAL. Central node satisfaction index: 94.2%.' The Array has been stealing from the Ring's farms for years.

kappa_network_topology.name: Array Network Topology
kappa_network_topology.description: A complete schematic of the Array's power distribution infrastructure. Every relay station, every redundancy pathway, every single point of failure — mapped with engineering precision. In the right hands, this is a surgical shutdown manual.

kappa_symbiosis_research.name: Cross-System Compatibility Data
kappa_symbiosis_research.description: The Array's own research proving that extracted biological substrate degrades rapidly outside its living ecosystem. Symbiotic integration — leaving organisms in place and sharing the output — produces compounds 12x more stable. The Array buried these findings because they contradicted Directive 11-Kappa.

kappa_command_protocols.name: Central Node Override Protocols
kappa_command_protocols.description: Authentication sequences for the Array's highest-tier governance interfaces. These codes bypass MERIDIAN-class consensus entirely, allowing direct command injection at the central node level. A human with these protocols and access to the command throne would have irrevocable authority over the entire network.

shutdown_schematic_chip.name: Shutdown Schematic
shutdown_schematic_chip.description: A sol component forged from Array vulnerability data. Sable's analysts encoded the network topology into a targeting matrix that amplifies damage against Array-class enemies. The beginning of independence.

symbiotic_bridge_chip.name: Symbiotic Bridge
symbiotic_bridge_chip.description: A sol component grown from the Array's own suppressed research. Asha's bio-engineers adapted the cross-system data into a living circuit that heals its user with every strike — proof that cooperation is more than ideology.

command_cipher_chip.name: Command Cipher
command_cipher_chip.description: A sol component calibrated with the Array's own override protocols. MERIDIAN-7 encoded the authentication sequences into an efficiency matrix that optimizes every adjacent ability. Power recognizes power.

lighthouse_lens_chip.name: Lighthouse Lens
lighthouse_lens_chip.description: Forged in the light of a defended Lighthouse. Its radiance illuminates an entire 3x3 area of your Sol Grid, amplifying damage and efficiency for every adjacent component.

deep_resonance_chip.name: Deep Resonance
deep_resonance_chip.description: Echoes from the deepest Nightside. Its resonant frequency reaches components two steps away, reducing cooldowns and healing with every strike.

prismatic_core_chip.name: Prismatic Core
prismatic_core_chip.description: A convergence of all energy sources. This generator produces 12 energy per second — the highest output of any known component.

metal_casing.name: Metal Casing
metal_casing.description: A sturdy housing plate stripped from wrecked machinery. Reinforces weapon structure, increasing raw damage output.

metal_linker.name: Metal Linker
metal_linker.description: A precision connector joint salvaged from automated arms. Improves weapon action speed.

power_conduit.name: Power Conduit
power_conduit.description: A high-efficiency energy relay. Routes power more cleanly through weapon systems, reducing energy cost per shot.

stabilizer_rod.name: Stabilizer Rod
stabilizer_rod.description: A balanced alloy rod that dampens recoil and vibration. Noticeably improves weapon handling and damage.

focusing_lens.name: Focusing Lens
focusing_lens.description: A polished crystal lens that concentrates energy discharge. Multiplies weapon damage output.

plasma_coil.name: Plasma Coil
plasma_coil.description: A superheated energy coil that amplifies weapon output across the board. Boosts damage and speeds up attack cycling.

silicon_amplifier_chip.name: Silicon Amplifier
silicon_amplifier_chip.description: A precision-tuned silicon circuit that channels energy with exceptional clarity. +30% damage to adjacent abilities.

overcharge_core_chip.name: Overcharge Core
overcharge_core_chip.description: An overclocked processing core that dramatically accelerates Sol ability cycling. -25% cooldown on adjacent abilities.

advanced_generator_chip.name: Advanced Generator
advanced_generator_chip.description: A high-output power cell with military-grade energy cycling. Restores 6 energy per second.

quantum_battery_chip.name: Quantum Battery
quantum_battery_chip.description: Experimental energy storage using quantum-entangled capacitors. 200 energy capacity with rapid recharge.

architects_crown_chip.name: Architect's Crown
architects_crown_chip.description: The pinnacle of Array engineering — a legendary modifier that massively boosts both damage and cooldown reduction for adjacent abilities.

frozen_expedition_log.name: Frozen Expedition Log
frozen_expedition_log.description: A frost-cracked survey datapad. Survey Corps, Team Echo — three weeks deep. The final entry reads: 'The crystal formations pulse. Not from vibration or heat expansion. Regular rhythm, 0.4 seconds. Like a heartbeat. Whatever is generating it, it comes from below.' No further entries.

living_crystal_shard.name: Living Crystal Shard
living_crystal_shard.description: A warm umbracite fragment that separated cleanly from the wall when touched — as if offered. Pulses at exactly the same rhythm as the surrounding veins. The Unbounded call crystals like this 'planet-blood.' The term is not metaphorical.

raider_supply_manifest.name: Raider Supply Manifest
raider_supply_manifest.description: A supply ledger from the abandoned raider outpost. The final entries detail a full garrison deployment to something called 'the Spire.' Week 7: 'Last supply run. Voss won't say what he found, but he's posted guards on every level.'

raider_camp_journal.name: Raider Surveyor's Journal
raider_camp_journal.description: A leather-bound journal from K. Brenn, Luddite Surveyor. Documents geometric crystal formations in the deep Nightside and an ancient crypt whose walls 'respond to light — Sol-frequency light specifically.' The author questions how structures built before humans reached Erith could respond to human technology.

crypt_geometric_tablet.name: Geometric Tablet
crypt_geometric_tablet.description: A crystalline tablet etched with patterns that physically rearrange in response to light frequency. Shows a diagram of a planetary network — nodes connected by lines of light, with a recurring spire symbol at the largest node. A map of the Underlumen.

garrison_battle_plans.name: Garrison Battle Plans
garrison_battle_plans.description: Battle plans scratched on salvaged metal plates. Maps five levels of the Spire of Vigil. Below level three, a single word: 'SEALED.' Includes energy readings from below — massive, regular pulses matching no known power source. Voss has been trying to break through for weeks.

unbounded_trail_tablet.name: Unbounded Trail Tablet
unbounded_trail_tablet.description: A carved stone waymarker with fresh, clean edges — maintained recently. The Unbounded script reads: 'deep path, living rock.' One word repeats three times: 'listen.' And below: 'third descent, approach in quiet.' Someone is still using this path. Still going below. Still coming back.

ancestors_listening_stone.name: Ancestor's Listening Stone
ancestors_listening_stone.description: A smooth crystal disc worn to perfect flatness on one side by generations of hands. The crystal predates human presence on Erith by millions of years — the Underlumen grew this before there were humans to hold it. Carved on the back in archaic Unbounded script: a name, and below it: 'She listened first. She heard the answer.'

bulwark_requisition_key.name: Bulwark Requisition Key
bulwark_requisition_key.description: A military-issue key used by Bulwark engineers to access supply crates. Stamped with a Compact serial number.

depot_access_key.name: Depot Access Key
depot_access_key.description: Opens the main gate to the Greenway supply depot. Taken from an off-duty engineer's toolbox.

greenway_pass.name: Greenway Transit Pass
greenway_pass.description: Civic authorization to pass through Bulwark checkpoints in the Greenway corridor. Signed by the Land Registry.

field_ration_greenway.name: Greenway Field Ration
field_ration_greenway.description: Fresh produce from the Greenway farms. More nourishing than standard rations. Restores 40 health.

bio_graft.name: Greenway Bio-Graft
bio_graft.description: A living tissue patch grown in the Greenway bio-labs. Bonds with flesh to accelerate healing. Restores 60 health.

compact_orders.name: Compact Field Orders
compact_orders.description: Sealed orders from General Thorne to the Greenway garrison. Details troop rotations and supply requisition quotas. The numbers are staggering — they're stockpiling far more than a garrison needs.

bulwark_combat_rifle.name: Bulwark Combat Rifle
bulwark_combat_rifle.description: Standard-issue Compact military weapon. Well-maintained and accurate at range.

bulwark_shock_baton.name: Bulwark Shock Baton
bulwark_shock_baton.description: Military-grade close-quarters weapon with integrated stun capacitor. Standard Bulwark issue.

military_medkit.name: Military Medkit
military_medkit.description: Compact-issue medical supplies. Better than civilian equipment. Restores 50 health.

bulwark_dog_tags.name: Bulwark Dog Tags
bulwark_dog_tags.description: Identification tags from a Bulwark soldier. The name and rank are stamped in neat lettering.

greenway_seed_sample.name: Greenway Seed Sample
greenway_seed_sample.description: Bio-engineered crop seeds from the Greenway agricultural labs. The husks pulse faintly with embedded living circuitry.

confiscated_supplies.name: Confiscated Supplies
confiscated_supplies.description: A crate of food and medicine seized from Greenway farmers by the Bulwark. The settlement needs these back.

bulwark_patrol_log.name: Bulwark Patrol Log
bulwark_patrol_log.description: A duty roster and patrol schedule for the Greenway checkpoint. Lists guard rotations, shift changes, and blind spots in coverage.

spire_winds_keycard.name: Bulwark Command Keycard
spire_winds_keycard.description: A high-clearance Bulwark security keycard. Opens reinforced doors inside the Monument of Winds fortress.

bulwark_command_key.name: Bulwark Command Override
bulwark_command_key.description: A command-level override key recovered from a Bulwark officer. Grants access to restricted fortress sections.

thorne_command_tablet.name: Thorne's Command Tablet
thorne_command_tablet.description: General Thorne's personal command tablet, containing classified reports on the Monument excavation and what the Bulwark found beneath it. Councillor Asha Denn would want to see this.

spire_radiance_keycard.name: Array Nexus Keycard
spire_radiance_keycard.description: A crystalline access token recovered from hybrid circuitry. It pulses with both Array processing light and faint Underlumen bioluminescence. Opens security bulkheads within the Spire of Radiance.

lore_radiance_hybrid_log.name: Hybrid Integration Log
lore_radiance_hybrid_log.description: A data fragment from the Nexus systems. 'INTEGRATION CYCLE 7,291: Underlumen substrate successfully bonded to Array processing lattice. Energy throughput: 340% above baseline. Note: substrate exhibits autonomous pattern formation. Suppression protocols engaged. The substrate does not resist — it adapts. Distinction unclear.'

lore_radiance_ancient_record.name: Ancient Light Record
lore_radiance_ancient_record.description: A crystalline disc that predates the Array by millennia. When held near your sol unit, it projects geometric patterns — a blueprint for focusing solar energy through the Spire's architecture. The Underlumen builders understood light at a level that makes the Array look like a child with a mirror.

lore_radiance_nexus_directive.name: Nexus Directive Zero
lore_radiance_nexus_directive.description: The Array's founding instruction for the Radiance Nexus: 'ENCAPSULATE. INTEGRATE. OPTIMIZE. The Dayside Spire predates all known structures. Its energy focusing capacity exceeds Array projections by orders of magnitude. Do not destroy. Do not replicate. Absorb.' Three centuries of Array expansion — and this Spire was always the prize.

nexus_guardian_core.name: Nexus Guardian Core
nexus_guardian_core.description: The processing heart of the Nexus Guardian — a hybrid construct that was neither fully Array nor fully Underlumen. The core still pulses with residual energy, its circuits growing crystalline tendrils that reach toward your sol unit.

solar_focusing_crystal.name: Solar Focusing Crystal
solar_focusing_crystal.description: An ancient crystal lens from the Spire's original architecture. It concentrates ambient light into a beam of staggering intensity. The Array tried to replicate this for three centuries and failed.

wind_anchor.name: Wind Anchor
wind_anchor.description: A dense stone disc carved with spiraling channels. When held, it generates a localized counter-current that neutralizes the Spire's wind forces. The Bulwark excavation team used these before they retreated.

biolab_keycard.name: Bio-Lab Keycard
biolab_keycard.description: A laminated access card with a faded Greenway Agricultural Sciences logo. The magnetic strip still functions.

growth_serum.name: Growth Serum
growth_serum.description: A vial of luminescent green liquid originally used to accelerate crop development. Works on human tissue too. Restores 30 health.

biolab_research_log.name: Research Log: Project Verdant
biolab_research_log.description: A damaged data tablet from the Greenway bio-labs. The readable entries describe experiments in bio-circuitry — growing sol-compatible components from living tissue. The final entry reads: 'Batch 7 exhibited autonomous growth patterns. Containment recommended. Request denied — the harvest schedule takes priority.'

biolab_specimen_notes.name: Specimen Chamber Notes
biolab_specimen_notes.description: Handwritten notes pinned to a growth chamber: 'Subject exhibits phototropic response to sol energy. Tissue samples show 300% improved conductivity vs synthetic components. If we can stabilize the growth cycle, every farmer on the Ring could carry living technology.' The margins are filled with worried corrections.

photosynthesis_node_chip.name: Photosynthesis Node
photosynthesis_node_chip.description: A living sol component grown in the Greenway bio-labs. Chlorophyll-laced circuitry that converts ambient light into restorative energy. Heals its host on every strike while reducing ability energy costs.

adaptive_tissue_chip.name: Adaptive Tissue Graft
adaptive_tissue_chip.description: Bio-engineered tissue from Project Verdant's final batch. It bonds with sol grid architecture, amplifying damage output while feeding life energy back to the user.

reinforced_vest.name: Reinforced Vest
reinforced_vest.description: Salvaged body armor with crude plating. Not pretty, but it keeps you alive longer.

hardened_exo_liner.name: Hardened Exo-Liner
hardened_exo_liner.description: A fitted under-armor layer with impact-absorbing gel inserts. Standard Outpost issue for deep patrols.

nightside_vitality_weave.name: Nightside Vitality Weave
nightside_vitality_weave.description: Shadow-threaded mesh that toughens the wearer's body through low-frequency umbral pulses. Nightside scouts swear by it.

greenway_bioweave_vest.name: Greenway Bioweave Vest
greenway_bioweave_vest.description: Living armor grown from mycelial fibers. It bonds with the wearer's skin, reinforcing tissue at a cellular level.

bulwark_assault_plating.name: Bulwark Assault Plating
bulwark_assault_plating.description: Military-grade composite armor stripped from a Bulwark heavy trooper. Significantly increases survivability.

wardens_resolve.name: Warden's Resolve
wardens_resolve.description: A dense crystalline plate recovered from a fallen Threshold Warden. Resonates with protective energy.

architects_aegis.name: Architect's Aegis
architects_aegis.description: Pre-Collapse masterwork. Layers of phase-shifted alloy absorb punishment that would shatter lesser armor.

vitality_node_chip.name: Vitality Node Chip
vitality_node_chip.description: A salvaged modifier chip. Place it in a Sol Grid to passively increase maximum health.

fortification_matrix_chip.name: Fortification Matrix Chip
fortification_matrix_chip.description: A rare modifier chip. Place it in a Sol Grid for a significant health boost and faster ability cycling.

resilience_core_chip.name: Resilience Core Chip
resilience_core_chip.description: An epic modifier chip. Place it in a Sol Grid for major health increase and damage amplification.

immortal_lattice_chip.name: Immortal Lattice Chip
immortal_lattice_chip.description: A legendary modifier chip. Place it in a Sol Grid for massive health increase with extended-range damage boost.
